name: light-tunnel
title: Light Tunnel
description: A full-screen swirl of curved light filaments converging into a dark vanishing point. The strands drift and carry racing comets, the centre bends toward the pointer, and a click sends a surge inward.
use: A hero or section needs a moving dark backdrop that reacts to the pointer without carrying any text.
avoid: A full-screen WebGL shader runs every frame, so it is heavy on phones and needs a sized parent.
a11y: Decorative and aria-hidden; reduced motion freezes the drift and switches off pointer steering and click surges. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Hundreds of thin white strands curve inward like a whirlpool, brightest toward the outer edge and fading into a black hole at the centre. Short bright comets ride along some strands, giving the dark field a sense of speed.
behaves: The whole swirl rotates and flexes slowly, bending its centre toward the pointer while streaks of light travel along the cables into the middle. Clicking sends a bright ring surging toward the vanishing point.
customise: Colours, speed, flow direction, pulse speed, length, width and density, cable count, thickness, waviness, sway, bend, centre, glow, fades, grain, mouse strength, click surge and light mode are props.
weight: heavy: A full-screen fragment shader redraws every frame while the page is visible.
